description: A slow evolving-population CV source: a distribution of traits is pushed apart by competition and smeared back together by mutation, so one cluster of birds can split into two and merge again.

params.text: Sets the speed evolution runs at, -8 to +4 octaves, with the centre giving 8 units of evolutionary time per second.
Sets the mutation diffusion between neighbouring traits, 0.00002 to 0.00012 on an exponential scale; low keeps the peaks distinct and high smooths them together.
Sets how local the competition is, 0.35 to 2.8 on an exponential scale; branching starts above 1, which is near 0.505 on the knob.
Sets the width of the environmental opportunity around the optimum, 0.20 to 0.45 trait units.
Sets where an injected mutant starts, up to 0.70 trait units either side of the current environmental optimum.
Mixes a narrow cohort of mutants into the population at the offset MUTANT sets; it is an invasion attempt, and selection may wipe it out.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the mutation diffusion.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the competition locality.

inputs.text: Doubles the speed evolution runs at for every volt, added to the RATE knob; the two together are capped at +4.25 octaves, so positive volts stop tracking near the top of the knob.
Modulates the mutation diffusion, a tenth of the knob's range per volt through its attenuverter.
Modulates the competition locality, a tenth of the knob's range per volt through its attenuverter.
Moves the environmental optimum by 0.11 trait units per volt, clamped to -0.55 through +0.55.
A rising edge past 1V injects a mutant cohort at the offset MUTANT sets, which is what the SEED button also does.
A rising edge past 1V returns the population to one narrow ancestor at the current environmental optimum, without firing MERGE.

outputs.text: The fraction of the population in the lower-trait basin, 0 to 10V; before a split it carries the whole population.
The fraction of the population in the higher-trait basin, 0 to 10V; before a split it reads 0V.
The position of the lower-trait cluster at 2V per trait unit, from -2V to +2V; before a split both position outputs follow the same unresolved mean.
The position of the higher-trait cluster at 2V per trait unit, from -2V to +2V; before a split both position outputs follow the same unresolved mean.
The standard deviation of the trait distribution, 0 to 10V, reaching full scale at a spread of 0.5.
A 10V pulse 1ms long when a viable two-cluster state is accepted.
A 10V pulse 1ms long when a two-cluster state returns to one cluster.

notes: The default ecology is stabilising: the competition knob starts below the branching threshold, so the population stays as one peak until you turn COMPETE past about noon.
The field is stepped 500 times a second whatever the sample rate; the five continuous outputs are smoothed with a 20ms one-pole, and the two pulse outputs are not.
If RESET and SEED arrive on the same field tick, RESET wins and the seed is discarded; a reset tick does not also advance evolutionary time.
The screen draws the trait distribution as a filled curve, with the environmental opportunity behind it and the current optimum marked.
